title: Canonical ampleness of compact hyperbolic Kähler manifolds

issues.description: The pluricanonical-freeness corollary rests on a companion paper, [OpenAIFujita2026, Cor. 6.3]. That paper claims Fujita's freeness conjecture in all dimensions, which is itself a major open problem. The corollary is only as good as that companion result. It is not used for the main theorem.
issues.evidence: Proof: 'Apply Fujita freeness in its all-powers form \cite[Corollary~6.3]{OpenAIFujita2026} with L=K_X and exponent m-1>=n+1'.

coverage:
I read the full proof chain:
- Brody derivative bound.
- Existence of extremal discs: upper semicontinuity via Fatou on the outer annulus.
- Dilation and area-tail lemma; the identity P_q(f)-P_q(f_r)=2∫_r^1 A_{q,s} ds/s is correct.
- Boundary regularity: |f'|≤C(1-|z|)^{-1/2}, which gives W^{1,p} for p<4.
- Initial W^{1,p} frame via the local ∂̄-gauge and Oka–Grauert.
- Hardy-space boundary-unitary frame. S*MS=I a.e. follows from Wold. The rotation/Toeplitz argument gives the H^s bound, and the p0-integrability exponent p0(s-3/2)+1 checks out.
- Centered spray via the nonlinear ∂̄ equation and the Banach IFT. Q(z,0)=Q_ξ(z,0)=0, and F(t,0)=x with ∂_tF=zb_j.
- Hessian identities. Signs and Green normalizations are correct. On the trace/log-det boundary limit, the radii choice and the o(1) error estimate are valid.
- Volume estimate with q=-h, δ=1.
- Aubin–Yau twisted equation and the Ricci computation R_{h_t}=-h_t+tk.
- Cohomological limit.
- Nef + positive top self-intersection ⇒ big, via Morse inequalities.
- Moishezon + Kähler ⇒ projective.
- Kodaira lemma, klt perturbation, and the log cone theorem ⇒ ample.
- Nefness section (Poletsky envelope on K_X^* minus its zero section) and the smoothing appendix.

Numerical check: on the Poincaré disc with f(z)=z/2 and h=k=4|dw|^2/(1-|w|^2)^2, I confirmed both L A_h = n - A_{R_h} = 5/3 and log det N(0) = P_{R_h}(f) = log(9/16), which match to 1e-15. Consistency checks on flat tori and P^1 behave correctly: when hyperbolicity fails there is no maximizer, and for flat h=λk the constant disc forces λ≥1/2.
main_claim: A compact connected Kähler manifold with no nonconstant entire curves has ample K_X and is projective (Kobayashi's conjecture). The key new ingredient is a uniform pointwise volume bound, h^n ≥ e^{-D}(n/(2n+D))^n k^n, for every Kähler h with Ric(h) ≥ -h. It comes from extremal discs that maximize d(f) - P_h(f) - A_h(f), together with a boundary-unitary frame and a Hessian trace identity.
sibling_notes: No sibling entries for family 051 were on the board when I checked. The main theorem does not depend on companion papers. Only the corollaries do: OpenAIFujita2026 (Fujita freeness) and a semialgebraic-cover companion. Nefness is also independently available from Ou 2025 combined with Cao–Höring, so a flaw in the disc proof of nefness would not be fatal. The paper claims a famous open conjecture, so the analytic core deserves an expert second look: the Hardy factor regularity and the spray IFT in Sections 4–5. Even so, every step I checked holds.
